purpose: Reject new input and recovery authority checks without waiting behind proof retirement.

baseline.reproduction: FAIL: with Authority.Close inside a blocked native-handle cleanup callback, ordinary input, observed input and recovery checks all remained blocked for the full 1-second observation (3/3). The fixture released cleanup and joined all goroutines afterward.

change.admission: checkResult uses TryRLock instead of RLock, matching the existing source-input and heartbeat admission policy. A pending or active Close rejects the check with ErrAuthority instead of adding a reader behind the writer.
change.ownership: Already admitted readers retain their read lock throughout the native query. Close still joins them before releasing handles, preserves its terminal error and closes handles once.
change.checks: An available authority still performs the original fresh native input/recovery check; no success is cached or substituted by a heartbeat.
change.interfaces: No API, DB, peer protocol, installer, repository hygiene, task runner, public signature or source-of-truth contract changes.

validation.focused: PASS: authority/input/recovery regression suite, 0.110s total. All three new checks returned ErrAuthority while cleanup remained blocked, with zero native-check callback invocations. This is a controlled synchronization test, not a measured field latency or guaranteed wall-clock deadline.
validation.preserved: PASS: concurrent readers still overlap and Close joins both; repeated Close preserves its first failure; observed checks cannot bypass guards or recovery; zero and service proofs remain rejected.
validation.package: PASS: go test -timeout 3m ./internal/inputworker, 25.599s, using Go 1.27.3 and the repository's runtime STW overlay.
validation.hygiene: PASS: gofmt on both changed Go files; git diff --check.
validation.skipped: Full repository, frontend, installer/release packaging and physical two-PC acceptance: this slice changes only internal authority lock admission, with no installed application changes.

remainingRisk: Already admitted native queries and Close itself may still wait for native work to finish; this change removes new-check queuing behind retirement. It does not establish the cause of historical error 1066 incidents or prove that handoff stutter is resolved.
